package.name: sysid_recorder
package.description: System identification data recorder for the crawler mower. Sends drive/turn commands (static const, step, or A*sin(B*t+T) waveforms) on /vehicle/cmd and records the response from /nanobot/gpsposition into CSV files, one folder per test type: static_calibration / dynamic_identification / coupling_identification. Switch tests at runtime by publishing a JSON string to /sysid_recorder/config.
